cuts.ofreeRecent: a starship data archive — kneeling on the ground; a present-day museum gallery of Three Kingdoms relics — standing; a small amateur astronomy club's indoor planetarium after a rehearsal — she removes an oversized lightweight foam planet prop from her lap; a silent zero-gravity recreation chamber on an orbital station — she playfully redirects the floating soft ball with one open palm; an archery range of targets on a green field — standing; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — sitting on the ground; a starship observation deck with a vast curved window onto a nebula — standing; the entryway of her home with a shoe bench — sips a tall iced coffee in a clear cup with a straw through the straw; a backstage dressing room with a bulb-lit mirror — holds a smartphone at chest height; an inn kitchen with clay stoves — standing; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — checks the photo on the back screen of a camera at chest height; the Wuhou Shrine in Chengdu — holds a red oil-paper umbrella open over her shoulder; a coin laundromat late at night — standing close to a high shelf or line
